NoSQLServer v0.73 validation
============================

Runtime
-------
ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 (64-bit, build 3 August 2026)

Scope
-----
v0.73 adds a native read-only JSON relation provider using the `json.cls`
package shipped with ooRexx 5.3.0. JSON documents are not automatically
flattened. A caller explicitly registers a relational projection consisting of:

  * relation/table name
  * JSON row path
  * exact projected column names
  * per-column JSON paths
  * relational types / nullability

Supported projection path surface:

  $                 document/current root
  .member           object member
  [0]               zero-based array element
  [*]               row expansion (row paths only)

A projected nested object/array crosses the relational boundary as canonical
JSON text. Missing projected paths become SQL NULL. Declared relational column
types are coerced/validated by TableDefinition. The provider is read-only and
performs a full document scan for each query; no JSON index or predicate
pushdown is advertised.

Focused regression
------------------
tests/v073_json_relation_smoke.rex: PASS

The regression proves:
  explicit JSON projection registration        PASS
  no automatic document flattening             PASS
  nested object path projection                 PASS
  nested array index projection                 PASS
  INTEGER / BOOLEAN relational predicates      PASS
  ORDER BY over projected numeric value         PASS
  nested array -> canonical JSON text           PASS
  missing nested path -> SQL NULL               PASS
  two projections from one JSON document        PASS
  compound INNER JOIN ON between projections    PASS
  federated catalog / table metadata             PASS
  Database Core queryTable visibility            PASS
  mutation rejected as SQLUNSUPPORTED            PASS
  malformed JSON rejected as STORAGEERROR        PASS

Provider boundary
-----------------
JsonDatabaseEngine is consumed through the existing external-engine relation
contract. No JSON-specific branch was added to FederatedDatabaseEngine JOIN,
metadata, mutation ownership, SQL parsing, or the Database Core adapter.

msqlshim v0.10 integration
---------------------------
msqlshim v0.10 was rebound to the v0.73 NoSQLServer.cls without shim source
changes.

  normal MySQL text-protocol smoke                PASS
  idle multi-client isolation                     PASS
  JSON relation over COM_QUERY                    PASS

The JSON wire query was:

  SELECT order_id,buyer_id
  FROM json_orders
  WHERE product='ABC123'
  ORDER BY order_id

and returned exactly:

  PO12345 | 123456
  PO30000 | 123456

Scope boundary
--------------
v0.73 does not add SQL JSON functions, implicit schema inference, recursive
flattening, JSON mutation, JSON indexes, JSON predicate pushdown, or JSONPath
beyond the documented small projection subset. Those are separate future
surfaces and must not be inferred from this provider.

Final packaged acceptance
-------------------------
A fresh extraction of the candidate ZIP verified:
  manifest payload entries                        166/166 PASS
  shipped .cls/.rex compile targets               91
  rexxc failures                                  0
  v073 native JSON relation                       PASS
  v072 general INNER JOIN ON                      PASS
  v071 external mutation boundary                 PASS
  v070 external metadata boundary                 PASS

msqlshim v0.10 was then rebound to the freshly extracted `NoSQLServer.cls`.
The JSON COM_QUERY smoke, normal wire smoke, and idle multi-client smoke all
passed. No msqlshim source changes were required.
